identity.title: Neutral atomic and molecular gas dynamics in the nearby spiral galaxies NGC 1512, NGC 4535, and NGC 7496

paper_type_evidence.quote: Using MeerKAT H I  and PHANGS-ALMA CO observations at resolutions of 15 ″ and $\sim\SI{1}{\arcsecond}$, respectively, we employed the $^{\text{3D}}$Barolo$,$ tilted ring fitting code

question.value: Can H I kinematics constrain the disk orientation so as to improve CO and H I rotation curve determination, and what radial motions/mass flows do they show?

evidence.quote: The hypothesis is that H I can provide a good probe of the gas disk’s intrinsic orientation, as long as additional factors that affect H I and CO are taken into consideration on a galaxy-by-galaxy basis.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: CO spectral resolution 2.5 km/s; H I 5.5 km/s per channel

evidence.quote: The spectral resolution is 2.5 km s^−1^.
The PHANGS-ALMA survey presents 90 nearby ($d\leq\SI{20}{\mega\parsec}$ ) galaxies targeting CO J=2$\rightarrow$1 emission

angular_resolution.value: ~1 arcsec (~100 pc) for CO(2-1); 15 arcsec for MeerKAT H I

evidence.quote: at an angular resolution of ${\sim}1''$ which corresponds to linear scales of ${\sim}\SI{100}{\parsec}$

provided.value: H I 21cm cubes, 6 h per galaxy, 15 arcsec, 5.5 km/s

evidence.quote: The galaxies (see [\[table:Properties\]](#table:Properties)) were each observed for 6 hours in a frequency range from 1.411 GHz to 1.414 GHz.

what.value: PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) data products (cubes, moment1 wprior maps)

evidence.quote: To trace the molecular component we used observations from the PHANGS-ALMA survey (cite: 2021ApJS..257...43L).

what.value: Previous CO rotation curves for comparison and initial Vrot

evidence.quote: We overplotted the results with previous RCs derived by (cite: 2020ApJ...897..122L), which represent the latest kinematic analysis of these galaxies.
Star formation rates taken from (cite: 2019ApJS..244...24L)

masking.value: CO: PHANGS 'moment1 wprior' map from strict mask; H I strict mask (core S/N>4 in 2 channels, outer S/N>2)

evidence.quote: we used another product offered by the PHANGS-ALMA pipeline, the "moment1 wprior" map.

what.value: Strict masking procedure for H I

evidence.quote: We used the strict masking procedure described in (cite: 2021ApJS..257...43L) that was initially used for the PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) observations.
following an approach similar to (cite: 2021ApJ...923..220D), we fit the radial velocities in a singular run

unstated_but_needed: ALMA project codes and PHANGS-ALMA data product version
3DBarolo version and parameter file (ring separation, Bezier order, mask/normalization settings)

method.value: 3D tilted-ring fits in staged runs: free fit, fix center/Vsys, regularize geometry, fit Vrot and sigma

evidence.quote: Once the geometry of the galaxy is fixed, the kinematics are fitted.

key_parameters.value: ring width 15 arcsec; weighting |cos θ|^2; rings with Vrot errors >±30 km/s dropped

evidence.quote: Rings that have large error bars ($>\SI{\pm30}{\kilo\meter\per\second}$) on the V$_{\text{rot}}$ values are neglected from here on.
based on $^{\text{3D}}$Barolo’s default error calculation method

validation.value: Residual maps, scale height tests, comparison with literature

evidence.quote: we created residual maps by subtracting the modeled velocities from the observations

method.value: Start from H I best fit; fix center and Vsys; thin disk z0=100 pc; fit i, phi, Vrot, sigma then fix geometry

evidence.quote: After a first initial fitting stage where $i$, $\phi$, V$_{\text{rot}}$, and $\sigma_{\text{gas}}$ are kept free to vary, the geometry ($i$ and $\phi$) is fixed

validation.value: Compared to Lang et al. 2020 curves

evidence.quote: Overall the circular velocities derived by $^{\text{3D}}$Barolo  agree well with the values from the previous work by (cite: 2020ApJ...897..122L)

analysis_steps.goal: Radial velocities and mass flow rates

method.value: Fit Vrad with other parameters fixed, sin^2 φ weighting; Mdot=2πRΣHI Vrad ×1.33 for helium

evidence.quote: the H I  mass flow $\dot{M}_{\text{HI}}$ is multiplied by the factor 1.33 which takes the primordial abundance of helium into account
when assuming that the H I  emission is optically thin

used_for.value: 3D tilted ring fits of H I and CO

evidence.quote: we compute rotation curves using $^{\text{3D}}$Barolo which fits tilted ring models to emission line data cubes in three dimensions

findings_qualitative.value: H I and CO rotation curves agree for most overlapping radii; radial flows are consistent with little net mass flow except NGC 1512.

evidence.quote: The H I  and CO circular velocities are in agreement for most bins where measurements overlap.

claims.hypothesis: H I-derived orientation can be used to fit CO rotation curves
claims.experiment: H I-based geometry used as input for CO 3DBarolo fits and compared to Lang et al. 2020
claims.result: CO and H I curves agree in most overlapping bins
claims.finding: Recommend using H I to model disk orientation before deriving CO RCs

evidence.quote: This is why we recommend using H I to correctly model the disk orientation parameters before deriving CO-based RCs.

limitations_admitted.value: Small sample and large uncertainties preclude definitive conclusions on radial flows

evidence.quote: The limited sample size and the presence of substantial uncertainties in our data preclude us from making definitive conclusions.

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA project codes and data versions
reproducibility.score_reason: Public PHANGS products but H I data and fit settings partly unspecified.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: MeerKAT cubes and detailed settings not stated as public.
